name: gong
description: Gong revenue intelligence — calls, transcripts, AI briefs, CRM entity search (official MCP server, read-only)

requirements: Gong account with a paid seat
OAuth client — registration is automatic (marketplace/OAuth) or manual (Gong issues a client id + secret)
OAuth scope mcp:read, mcp:write, or both
notes: The Gong MCP server is READ-ONLY: it never creates, updates or deletes Gong or CRM data.
ask_account, ask_deal, generate_brief and research_conversations consume Gong credits.
search_conversations, get_transcript, get_session_context, search_crm_entities and search_person_entities consume no credits.
Some tools only work with personal-access authorization.
The setup flow offers an `mcp:write` scope, but no write tool is documented today — treat it as future-proofing, not current capability. Token endpoint: https://app.gong.io/oauth2/generate-mcp-token.
